formula.name: Green Patchouli Cologne Lean — Citrus Patchouli Chypre
formula.body:
### STEP 1 — BASE (add first, swirl after every 3)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 1 | Galaxolide | 50% in DEP | 700 | 0.700 |
| 2 | Iso E Super | neat | 500 | 0.500 |
| 3 | Patchouli EO | neat | 380 | 0.380 |
| 4 | Ambrox Super | 30% w/v | 320 | 0.320 |
| 5 | Clearwood | neat | 300 | 0.300 |
| 6 | Benzyl Salicylate | neat | 300 | 0.300 |
| 7 | Vetiver EO | neat | 250 | 0.250 |
| 8 | Romandolide | neat | 220 | 0.220 |
| 9 | Cedramber | neat | 220 | 0.220 |
| 10 | Coumarin | 20% in EtOH | 120 | 0.120 |
| 11 | Evernyl | neat | 20 | 0.020 |

**Base subtotal: 3,330 µL — swirl until homogeneous before proceeding.**

---

### STEP 2 — HEART (add second, swirl after each)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 12 | Hedione | neat | 600 | 0.600 |
| 13 | Geraniol | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 14 | Lavender EO | neat | 100 | 0.100 |

**Heart subtotal: 850 µL — swirl after addition.**

---

### STEP 3 — TOP (add last, work quickly, cap immediately)

| # | Material | Dilution | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----------|----|-----|
| 15 | Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian | neat | 350 | 0.350 |
| 16 | Grapefruit FCF | neat | 200 | 0.200 |
| 17 | Petitgrain EO | neat | 150 | 0.150 |
| 18 | Black Pepper EO | neat | 90 | 0.090 |

**Top subtotal: 790 µL — cap beaker immediately after last addition.**

---

### STEP 4 — ETHANOL

| # | Material | µL | mL |
|--:|----------|----|----|
| 19 | Ethanol 96% | 25,030 | 25.030 |

Add in 3 portions (~8 mL each). Swirl 15 seconds between each.

---

**Concentrate: 4,970 µL (16.6%) · Total: 30,000 µL · 30 mL · 18 materials**

---

## CHECKLIST

- [ ] Label beaker: *Green Patchouli Cologne Lean — 30 mL — YYYY-MM-DD*
- [ ] Zero balance
- [ ] Step 1 — Base (11 materials) complete, swirled
- [ ] Step 2 — Heart (3 materials) complete, swirled
- [ ] Step 3 — Top (4 materials) complete, capped immediately
- [ ] Step 4 — Ethanol added in 3 portions
- [ ] Transferred to 30 mL amber atomiser
- [ ] Macerating — do not evaluate before day 14

---

## MACERATION

| Day | Expectation |
|-----|-------------|
| 0 | Patchouli raw, pepper sharp — do not evaluate |
| 7 | First integration, patchouli rounds out |
| **14** | **First evaluation** — chypre character readable |
| 30 | Peak — patchouli-Clearwood fused, Ambrox blooming |
| 45 | Vetiver depth fully developed |

---

## VS 26-MATERIAL VERSION

| | 26-material | 18-material |
|--|-------------|-------------|
| Materials | 26 | **18** |
| Concentrate | 5,643 µL | 4,970 µL |
| EdP strength | 18.8% | **16.6%** |
| Patchouli EO | 313 µL | **380 µL** |
| Musk chord | 3 musks | **2 musks** |
| Mixing steps | ~26 pipette moves | **~18 pipette moves** |
| Character | Same — patchouli chypre |

*Pipeline not yet run. Awaiting mix and wear test.*

Far-field: Lavender EO, Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian, Grapefruit FCF, Petitgrain EO
Mid-field: Iso E Super, Patchouli EO, Ambrox Super, Vetiver EO, Cedramber
Near-field: Galaxolide, Clearwood, Benzyl Salicylate, Romandolide

mixing_protocol.title: Green Patchouli Cologne Lean — Citrus Patchouli Chypre

instructions: 1. Dissolve Coumarin in warm ethanol or DPG (40-50°C) until fully clear before adding to formula.

Step 2. Add Ambrox Super (6.44%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 3. Add Galaxolide (14.08%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 4. Add Iso E Super (10.06%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 5. Add Cedramber (4.43%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 6. Add Benzyl Salicylate (6.04%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.

Step 7. Add Romandolide (4.43%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
→ Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

Step 8. Add Patchouli EO (7.65%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 9. Add Vetiver EO (5.03%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 10. Add Black Pepper EO (1.81%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 11. Add Clearwood (6.04%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 12. Add Bergamot FCF oil Sicilian (7.04%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 13. Add Petitgrain EO (3.02%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 14. Add Hedione (12.07%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.

Step 15. Add Evernyl (0.4%)
           Heart note — forms the core character.
→ Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

Step 16. Add Grapefruit FCF (4.02%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.

Step 17. Add Geraniol (3.02%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.

Step 18. Add Lavender EO (2.01%)
           Top note — most volatile, add last to preserve freshness.
→ Stir gently for 2-3 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes.

mixing_protocol.full_text:
═══ MIXING PROTOCOL: Green Patchouli Cologne Lean — Citrus Patchouli Chypre ═══
Materials: 18 | Total: 100.0%

─── WARNINGS ───
⚠ CRYSTALLINE SOLIDS: Coumarin — dissolve in warm solvent before adding.

─── PHASE 0: DISSOLUTION ───
  1. Dissolve Coumarin in warm ethanol or DPG (40-50°C) until fully clear before adding to formula.

─── PHASE 1: BASE LAYER (foundation) ───
  Step 2. Add Ambrox Super (6.44%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 3. Add Galaxolide (14.08%)
           Base note — add early for structural foundation.
  Step 4. Add Iso E Super (10.06%)
